summary: Banco Santander filed a Form 6-K on April 29, 2026, presenting its Q1 2026 earnings results, including a forward-looking statement disclaimer and non-IFRS measures. The filing is a routine periodic earnings report by a foreign issuer, not a special situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is mentioned. The filing updates investors on financial performance but does not trigger any special-situations category.
